title: PLA film contact angles across substrates and solvents
source_scope: PLA films and substrate controls with water formamide and diiodomethane

title: Carbon surface functionalization contact angles
source_scope: carbon surfaces with water glycerol and diiodomethane
notes: Table 4 contains 6 surfaces and three static contact-angle columns; reported SFE is treated as angle-derived rather than independent.

title: Reusable facemask contact-angle table
source_scope: seven facemask surfaces with water formamide and diiodomethane
notes: Table 2 contains triplicate static angles; non-commercial license requires attribution and must be preserved in any public derived-data release.

title: Chitosan-gelatin film wettability table
source_scope: biopolymer films with glycerin and diiodomethane
notes: Table 3 contains seven static film surfaces and two liquids; glycerin is canonicalized to glycerol and calculated SFE is not used as an independent input.
